== EventPreview Journey Overture Preview ==
Sword × Staff launches soon!

Get a sneak peek at the celebration waiting for you in Journey Overture.

Slip into the iconic salted fish outfit and enjoy the adventure in true laid-back style.

See you in Kanstein, Adventurers!

Event duration: May 19th to June 1st.

== Event Content ==
[[File:旅程庆典-长图-EN.jpg|right|1965x1965px]]

=== ''01 Overture Sign-In'' ===
Join Overture Sign-In during the event and claim daily rewards! Sign in for 14 days to get the free Visage: Salted Splash.

=== ''02 Overture Outfit'' ===
The limited-time Visage: Phantom Purr will be featured during the event at a special price of 499 + 299 Vouchers!

=== ''03 Overture Shuffle'' ===
Overture Shuffle will be available during the event! Clear stages to earn Overture Badges and exchange them for exclusive rewards.

=== ''04 Prize Punch'' ===
Complete event quests to earn Overture Tickets. Use tickets in Prize Punch for a chance to win grand prizes!

=== ''05 Overture Shop'' ===
The Overture Shop is coming with 9 brand-new Emoticons available for exchange!

=== ''06 Overture Packs'' ===
Exclusive Overture Packs are on the way for a limited time!

Get the all-new exclusive Divine Relic: Sword × Staff for free!


Don't miss the exclusive Legendary Relic: Merri Doll at a special price!
